top_signals.title: Venus Williams on WeWard Deal and Her Investing Mindset
top_signals.summary: Tennis legend Venus Williams sat down with Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick in an exclusive interview on November 17, 2026, to talk about her origin story with WeWard and how she decided to invest in the walking app. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Oil Traders Ignore Growing Threat to Persian Gulf Supply
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices are down this week, extending a losing streak prompted by predictions of a supply glut. The ones doing the predictions are citing the rebound in export flows out of the Persian Gulf, but they seem to be forgetting something. These export flows were up in September and October. Now, they’re down. The war is not over, and neither is the risk to global oil supply.
